verdict: Citizens grew profit 29% to $636M as net interest income rose 13% on a wider lending margin — and it raised the dividend 13%.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Total revenue was $2,322M, vs $2,118M a year ago

kpis.label: Net interest income
kpis.note: up 13% YoY; net interest margin widened to 3.19%

segments.name: Net interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on loans and securities minus interest paid on deposits and borrowings — the bank's core engine. Margin widened 19 bps YoY to 3.19%.

segments.name: Noninterest income
segments.note: Fees and other non-interest income — record Wealth revenue partly offset lower Mortgage and Capital Markets fees.

opex.name: Salaries & employee benefits
opex.note: Pay and benefits — the biggest cost, up 6% YoY on the Private Bank and Wealth build-out.

opex.name: Outside services
opex.note: Outside help — up 8% YoY, including work on the 'Reimagine the Bank' program.

opex.name: Other operating expense
opex.note: Everything else it takes to run the bank.

oneTimers: Preferred stock early redemption costs were $4M in the quarter (noted in the release's per-share footnotes).
footerNote: For a bank, the provision for credit losses ($125M) plays the role of cost of revenue: revenue minus the provision and running costs gives pre-tax profit of $804M. Net income of $636M is before $37M of preferred dividends; $599M was available to common stockholders.

takeaways.title: The lending margin widened
takeaways.text: Net interest margin (fully taxable-equivalent) rose to 3.19%, up 19 bps from a year ago, driving net interest income up 13% to $1,675M. Average loans grew, led by the Private Bank.

takeaways.title: Credit stayed calm
takeaways.text: Net charge-offs were 0.37% of average loans, stable vs last quarter, and the provision for credit losses fell to $125M from $154M a year ago. The allowance covers 1.47% of loans.

takeaways.title: More cash back to owners
takeaways.text: Citizens raised its quarterly dividend 13% to $0.52 per share and expanded its buyback capacity to $1.95B. The Private Bank contributed $0.16 of the quarter's $1.41 EPS, with spot deposits of $18.5B.
